Here’s what's new: https://t.co/A2FdH045Tt

author: claudeai
text:
Introducing Claude Code Security, now in limited research preview.

It scans codebases for vulnerabilities and suggests targeted software patches for human review, allowing teams to find and fix issues that traditional tools often miss.

Learn more: https://t.co/n4SZ9EIklG https://t.co/zw9NjpqFz9

author: claudeai
text:
Claude in PowerPoint is now available on the Pro plan. 

It also now supports connectors, bringing context from your daily tools directly into your slides.

Try it here: https://t.co/N52VtGwcPj https://t.co/ZHXgdnbCNG

author: claudeai
text:
You can now push what you’re building in Claude Code directly into Figma.

With the latest updates to the Figma MCP server, build a working prototype in code, then send it to a Figma canvas to explore multiple versions. https://t.co/yW9XllB7aJ

author: claudeai
text:
Claude Code is turning one, and we’re throwing a birthday party.

Join fellow builders and the Claude Code team in San Francisco on Feb 21 for live demos, top hackathon projects, and cake. 

Come show us what you're building (spots are limited): https://t.co/Pgz9OGFm3j https://t.co/4UCGSRfXH2

author: claudeai
text:
Claude Sonnet 4.6 is available now on all plans, Cowork, Claude Code, our API, and all major cloud platforms.

We've also upgraded our free tier to Sonnet 4.6 by default—it now includes file creation, connectors, skills, and compaction.

See more: https://t.co/lN7BGMYoYn

author: claudeai
text:
For Claude in Excel users, our add-in now supports MCP connectors, letting Claude work with tools like S&P Global, LSEG, Daloopa, PitchBook, Moody’s and FactSet.

Pull in context from outside your spreadsheet without ever leaving Excel. https://t.co/hrkKpb2ePw

author: claudeai
text:
Sonnet 4.6 also shows a major improvement in computer use skills.

Early users are seeing human-level capability on tasks like complex spreadsheets and multi-step web forms. https://t.co/DcB3OWQa2a

author: claudeai
text:
Sonnet 4.6 has improved on benchmarks across the board.

It approaches Opus-level intelligence at a price point that makes it practical for far more tasks. https://t.co/pzgs2SeYtX

author: claudeai
text:
This is Claude Sonnet 4.6: our most capable Sonnet model yet.

It’s a full upgrade across coding, computer use, long-context reasoning, agent planning, knowledge work, and design.

It also features a 1M token context window in beta. https://t.co/TDId3XUSRs

author: claudeai
text:
Compaction is also now on the free plan.

Claude summarizes earlier context automatically, so long conversations can continue without starting over.

Get started: https://t.co/tHPAZRgQkn

author: claudeai
text:
We're bringing some of Claude’s most-used features to the free plan.

File creation, connectors, and skills are all now available without a subscription. https://t.co/6EjrwLTWVQ

author: claudeai
text:
Plus, you can now set global and folder instructions that Claude carries into every session.

Cowork on Windows is in research preview and available to all paid Claude plans: https://t.co/EYHUToVB4q

author: claudeai
text:
Cowork is now available on Windows.

We’re bringing full feature parity with MacOS: file access, multi-step task execution, plugins, and MCP connectors. https://t.co/329DqJz5q5

author: claudeai
text: @cursor_ai @emergentlabs @FactoryAI @figma @github @Lovable @v0 @windsurf We plan to expand API access to more customers. You can join the waitlist here: https://t.co/FKxOKmpEDV

author: claudeai
text:
Fast mode is available now for Claude Code users with extra usage enabled (use /fast).

It’s also available in research preview on @cursor_ai, @emergentlabs, @FactoryAI, @figma, @github Copilot, @Lovable, @v0, and @windsurf.

author: claudeai
text:
Fast mode is more expensive to run. It’s for urgent, high-stakes projects, combining impressive speed with Opus-level intelligence.

Read more: https://t.co/UzhxsPhLIp

author: claudeai
text:
Our teams have been building with a 2.5x-faster version of Claude Opus 4.6.

We’re now making it available as an early experiment via Claude Code and our API.

author: claudeai
text:
Announcing Built with Opus 4.6: a Claude Code virtual hackathon.

Join the Claude Code team for a week of building. Winners will be hand-selected to win $100K in Claude API credits.

Apply here: https://t.co/SkEg8Py1l2 https://t.co/w4OEIFOK0N

author: claudeai
text:
Claude Opus 4.6 is available today on https://t.co/tHPAZRgQkn, the Claude Developer Platform, and all major cloud platforms.

And within Cowork, Opus 4.6 can put all these skills to work autonomously on your behalf.

Read more: https://t.co/khElu0O5Vp

author: claudeai
text:
New on the API: we're giving developers better control over model effort and more flexibility for long-running agents.

Adaptive thinking lets Claude calibrate its reasoning depth to each task, and context compaction keeps long-running tasks from hitting limits.

author: claudeai
text:
On Claude Code, we’re introducing agent teams.

Spin up multiple agents that coordinate autonomously and work in parallel—best for tasks that can be split up and tackled independently.

Agent teams are in research preview: https://t.co/LdkPjzxFZg

author: claudeai
text:
Claude in PowerPoint is now available in research preview for Max, Team, and Enterprise.

Claude reads your layouts, fonts, and slide masters to stay on-brand — whether you're building from a template or generating a full deck from a description. https://t.co/1mwE677SCJ

author: claudeai
text:
Claude in Excel now handles long-running and harder tasks with improved performance.

It can plan before acting, support richer functionalities like conditional formatting and data validation, and handle multi-step changes in one pass.

Read more: https://t.co/EdHSOUsgFk https://t.co/YsInEo21HY

author: claudeai
text:
Opus 4.6 is state-of-the-art on several evaluations including agentic coding, multi-discipline reasoning, knowledge work, and agentic search.

We're also shipping new features across Claude in Excel, Claude in PowerPoint, Claude Code, and our API to let Opus 4.6 do even more. https://t.co/AN83Zb7Osg

author: claudeai
text:
Introducing Claude Opus 4.6. Our smartest model got an upgrade. 

Opus 4.6 plans more carefully, sustains agentic tasks for longer, operates reliably in massive codebases, and catches its own mistakes.

It’s also our first Opus-class model with 1M token context in beta. https://t.co/L1iQyRgT9x

author: claudeai
text: Ads are coming to AI. But not to Claude. Keep thinking. https://t.co/n2yECeBWyT

author: claudeai
text:
Claude is built to be a genuinely helpful assistant for work and for deep thinking.

Advertising would be incompatible with that vision.

Read why Claude will remain ad-free: https://t.co/Dr8FOJxINC

author: claudeai
text:
You can now connect Slack to Claude on Pro and Max plans.

Search your workspace channels, prep for meetings, and send messages back to keep work moving forward—without leaving your conversation with Claude.

Get started: https://t.co/p9xKFW2LUJ https://t.co/Y2mzo2QXUJ

author: claudeai
text:
A.A.Murakami create immersive, multi-sensory installations that merge technology with ephemeral natural phenomena like fog, bubbles, and plasma. 

In their latest piece, Claude serves as a studio collaborator. https://t.co/Iop6RS6v0S

author: claudeai
text:
Plugin support is available today as a research preview for all paid plans.

Org-wide sharing and management is coming soon.

Learn more: https://t.co/llpobxToOR

author: claudeai
text:
We're open-sourcing 11 plugins for sales, finance, legal, data, marketing, support, and more.

Get started here: https://t.co/lwXJVUsurX

author: claudeai
text:
Cowork now supports plugins. 

Plugins let you bundle any skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents together to turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. https://t.co/7RhhbZgcfD

author: claudeai
text:
Now available on the Free plan: Claude can create and edit files.

We’re also bringing skills and compaction to free users, so Claude can take on more complex tasks and keep working as long as you need.

quoted.text:
Claude can now create and edit files.

Turn conversations into Excel spreadsheets, documents, PowerPoint slide decks, and PDFs directly. https://t.co/F3yOiNMasU

author: claudeai
text: Research companies with @clay, find contacts and company info, and draft personalized outreach. https://t.co/oSHbijJV9N

author: claudeai
text: Search and preview your @box files, then ask Claude about what's inside. https://t.co/tbhlvl0wEt

author: claudeai
text:
Your work tools are now interactive in Claude.

Draft Slack messages, visualize ideas as Figma diagrams, or build and see Asana timelines. https://t.co/ROWwUOU5vA

author: claudeai
text:
Claude in Excel is now available on Pro plans.

Claude now accepts multiple files via drag and drop, avoids overwriting your existing cells, and handles longer sessions with auto compaction.

Get started: https://t.co/cAMDXM1h7r https://t.co/yt9Gy2HLY3

author: claudeai
text: Claude Cowork is now available for Team and Enterprise plans.

quoted.text:
Introducing Cowork: Claude Code for the rest of your work.

Cowork lets you complete non-technical tasks much like how developers use Claude Code. https://t.co/EqckycvFH3

author: claudeai
text:
Claude can now securely connect to your health data.

Four new integrations are now available in beta: Apple Health (iOS), Health Connect (Android), HealthEx, and Function Health. https://t.co/tTCnxOGt7i

author: claudeai
text:
The VS Code extension for Claude Code is now generally available. 

It’s now much closer to the CLI experience: @-mention files for context, use familiar slash commands (/model, /mcp, /context), and more.

Download it here: https://t.co/q95Cw4soMk https://t.co/3BCWPvybdZ

author: claudeai
text:
While still in research preview, we've also shipped session renaming, connector improvements, and fixes based on early feedback.

Since Cowork handles more complex work, Pro users may hit their usage limit sooner.

Try it in the macOS app: https://t.co/hwPB3zlk0w

author: claudeai
text: Claude Cowork is now available to Pro subscribers.

author: claudeai
text:
New in Claude Code on the web and desktop: diff view.

See the exact changes Claude made without leaving the app. https://t.co/q4KiMtTYGR

author: claudeai
text:
Once you've set a task, Claude makes a plan and steadily completes it, looping you in along the way.

Claude will ask before taking any significant actions so you can course-correct as needed.

author: claudeai
text:
In Cowork, you give Claude access to a folder on your computer. Claude can then read, edit, or create files in that folder.

Try it to create a spreadsheet from a pile of screenshots, or produce a first draft from scattered notes. https://t.co/GEaMgDksUp
